content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad provides a simple interface for selling digital products, but it excludes numerous markets, limiting access for creators. Stripe, while robust in functionality, operates in only 46 countries, leading to frustration for many. PayPal, another giant, can suspend accounts unexpectedly, freezing funds for up to 180 days without recourse. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a comprehensive solution that empowers creators with complete ownership of their sales process, enabling them to sell digital products seamlessly without reliance on conventional payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal both impose geographical restrictions that prevent creators in certain countries from accessing their services. This exclusion creates a frustrating barrier for those looking to monetize their digital products. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed specifically for these creators, allowing them to build and deploy their own online stores using tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This approach eliminates reliance on third-party platforms and ensures that creators can conduct business without interruptions or restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing fees are a significant concern for many creators. Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees that can quickly add up, especially for small sales. Furthermore, account holds can lead to cash flow issues. In contrast, with NOWPayments, creators enjoy a low fee of just 0.5% on over 300 cryptocurrencies, with minimal transaction costs on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON. This direct payment processing model ensures that creators receive their earnings promptly and without the fear of sudden account restrictions.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means full ownership, no dependencies.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the critical differentiators between traditional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership. Platforms like Gumroad and PayPal retain control over transactions and customer data, whereas COREMERCH provides full ownership to creators post-deployment. This means that after setting up a digital store, creators can automate payment processing and product delivery while retaining customer data, ensuring a seamless experience for buyers and sellers alike. The independence gained through this ownership structure is vital for sustainable business growth.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators currently using platforms like Gumroad but facing restrictions, transitioning to sovereign commerce infrastructure should be a priority. The Sovereign Starter Stack is an excellent entry point for those needing a quick setup, while the Edge Commerce Stack offers more advanced capabilities for those looking to scale. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) encompasses all necessary blueprints and templates, making it easier for creators to build a robust digital commerce stack tailored to their unique needs.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid account holds and freezes by controlling your payment processing.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
